name: G-N
summary: G-N, also known as 1,4-dimethoxynaphthyl-2-isopropylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, DOx, and naphthylethylamine families. It is one of several homologues of Ganesha (G).

uses.en: It has no medical use. It is a research compound described by Alexander Shulgin as one of the Ganesha homologues.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，是 Alexander Shulgin 描述過的 Ganesha 同系物之一，僅屬研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，是 Alexander Shulgin 描述过的 Ganesha 同系物之一，仅属研究用化合物。

fact.en: G-N swaps the benzene ring found in most phenethylamines for a naphthalene ring, two benzene rings fused together, the same ring system found in mothballs.
fact.zh: G-N 把多數苯乙胺類分子中的苯環換成了萘環，也就是兩個苯環並在一起的結構，和樟腦丸裡的萘是同一種環系。
fact.zhHans: G-N 把多数苯乙胺类分子中的苯环换成了萘环，也就是两个苯环并在一起的结构，和樟脑丸里的萘是同一种环系。
